name: Matar Pulao
description: Aromatic Pakistani matar pulao with basmati rice, green peas, browned onion and whole spices, finished on gentle dum for separate grains.
ingredients: 3 cups basmati rice, rinsed and soaked
Whole garam masala, such as bay leaf, cloves, cardamom and cinnamon
5 cups water or stock, adjusted for the rice and soaking
method: Rinse the basmati until the water is much clearer, soak it according to the rice you use, then drain well.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the sliced onion evenly; reserve a little for garnish if desired.
Add cumin and the whole garam masala and stir briefly until aromatic, then add the peas.
Pour in the water or stock, season with salt and bring it to a boil. Taste the liquid and correct the seasoning before adding rice.
Add the drained rice and cook uncovered until most of the liquid has been absorbed and small steam holes appear at the surface.
Cover tightly, reduce to low heat and steam for about 10 minutes, or until the grains are tender and separate.
Rest the covered pulao for a few minutes off the heat, then fluff gently from the sides so the grains do not break.
